description: This file defines the class `Value` which provides various static methods for evaluating different types and properties of values within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine, including checks for blank, reference, even/odd, number, logical, text, non-text, formula, type, and value conversions.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Provides static methods for evaluating and determining properties of values within spreadsheet calculations, including checks for blank values, references, numeric properties, logical values, text, formulas, and a method for converting to number types.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is blank (null or empty). Can handle arrays of values, returning array results with the same dimensions.

methods.name: isRef
methods.description: Determines if the given value represents a valid cell reference or named range, considering worksheet existence and coordinate bounds.

methods.name: isEven
methods.description: Checks if the numeric value is even. Returns error if input is invalid or non-numeric. Supports array input.

methods.name: isOdd
methods.description: Checks if the numeric value is odd. Returns error if input is invalid or non-numeric. Supports array input.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Tests whether the value is numeric. Returns false for string inputs, supports array input.

methods.name: isLogical
methods.description: Checks if the value is a boolean logical value. Supports array input.

methods.name: isText
methods.description: Checks if the value is a text string and not an error. Supports array input.

methods.name: isNonText
methods.description: Checks if the value is not text. Supports array input.

methods.name: isFormula
methods.description: Determines if a cell (or range) contains a formula, considering worksheet context and expressions. Supports array of cell references.

methods.name: asNumber
methods.description: Converts a value to a numeric type if possible, handling boolean and error cases.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns a numeric identifier representing the type of the provided value (number, text, logical, error, array).
